recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless a concrete current build artifact is later found with mismatched profile-table links and definitions anchors.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue reported that profile differential and snapshot table links for the CQIF KnowledgeModule profile omitted the Basic path segment, while the definitions page anchors included it; the Jira comment recorded that the target links were correct and the source links were wrong.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6607, represented in Git by 627d738f6a118ac01d8385645766639233954f78, which changed the old Java ProfileUtilities.makePathLink logic so named elements under dotted paths kept their path context when linking to definitions anchors.
additional_context: The old Java publisher/generator source touched by the 2015 fix is no longer present in the current FHIR checkout. The specific CQIF KnowledgeModule profile is not active in current core source, and source/fhir.ini lists KnowledgeModule under [removed-resources]. FHIR-8395 appeared in the same historical CQIF tooling neighborhood but concerned a separate nested complex extension build error, not this link/anchor mismatch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested correction is already represented in history and there is no current in-scope core source hunk to change.

related_jiras.note: Same historical CQIF KnowledgeModule/tooling neighborhood, but it addressed a nested complex extension build error rather than FHIR-8456's link/anchor mismatch and was not decided.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction reporting broken profile differential and snapshot links to CQIF KnowledgeModule definitions anchors.
evidence_items.learned: The approved request was to fix source links that omitted the Basic path segment, while keeping the definitions-page anchors as the correct target pattern.

evidence_items.summary: The historical commit '#8456 - fix extension links to dictionary' changed ProfileUtilities.makePathLink to preserve path context for named elements.
evidence_items.learned: This is the initial application of FHIR-8456 and matches the Jira comment identifying SVN revision 6607.
